Most features and the Google Drive import come from third-party directories and reviews. No company or legal entity name was found. The current blurb is in French, but the official site content is in English.

record.short_description: AI code generation tool that creates unit tests and documentation and refactors code in 56 languages
record.description: Refraction is an AI code generation tool for developers. Users paste a block of code, pick a language or framework, and generate output. It can create unit tests, write documentation, and refactor code, and it supports 56 languages, including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C#, Go, Rust, and SQL. Paid plans add editor extensions and unlimited history. Refraction also offers a VS Code extension that brings these commands into the editor, along with team features such as shared history and unified billing.
record.pricing_summary: Hobby is free for one user with 10 code generations. Pro costs $8/month (unlimited generations, history, and editor extensions), Team costs $14 per user per month, and Enterprise uses custom billing. Yearly billing is 15% off, and there is a free 7-day trial.
use_cases: Automate testing, documentation and refactoring tasks
record.notes: I checked the official homepage and pricing page through search results. The site's headline says 'Learn, improve and generate code with magic AI', so the current blurb is close but should drop the slogan. Futuretools lists outdated pricing ($5/month), but the official page shows $8 for Pro. The VS Code integration comes from Product Hunt, which says the extension uses the Refraction API. I couldn't confirm the company or legal entity name on the official site, and I hit the search limit before I could look further. Exact current site uptime wasn't checked directly beyond the indexed pages.

record.short_description: AI writing assistant plugin for WordPress and Chrome that generates web copy, SEO text, and images
record.description: Bertha AI is an AI-powered writing assistant offered as a WordPress plugin and a Chrome extension. Third-party sources say it generates SEO-optimized text, suggests titles and descriptions, and helps draft blog posts. It can write product descriptions for WooCommerce and Easy Digital Downloads from a product title. It also includes a chat interface for brainstorming and ideation, plus image generation. Sources say it supports content in many languages. This record relies on third-party sources because the official site could not be opened.
features: Product descriptions for WooCommerce and EDD
Chat interface for brainstorming and ideation
record.notes: The search tool hit its usage limit before I could open bertha.ai or its pricing page, so this record is based only on third-party pages (wpmarmite.com, wedevs.com, alternatives.co, unrealspeech.com). official_url is the listed domain with the ?ref=16638 tracking parameter removed. I did not confirm that the site is up, so status is unknown, and I could not find the company name. Pricing appears only on a directory site (alternatives.co): Starter at $20/mo, Pro at $45/mo, and Pro Unlimited at $150/mo, with a free trial and a 7-day money-back guarantee. wpmarmite gives a different figure of $160/year. Because none of this comes from bertha.ai, I left pricing_summary and pricing_source_url empty, set pricing_type to unknown, and set free_tier to false. The current blurb matches how third-party sources describe the product, a writing assistant for WordPress and Chrome.

record.short_description: AI voice platform with real-time voice changer, voice cloning, text to speech, and voice agents
record.description: Voice.ai is an AI audio platform best known for its free real-time voice changer for Windows PC and Mac. It works with apps such as Discord, Zoom, and games. Users can choose from thousands of community-made voices in its Voice Universe library or clone a voice from short audio samples. The platform also offers text to speech, a voice agent platform, audio tools like a vocal remover and audio enhancer, and APIs with Python and TypeScript SDKs for developers.
record.pricing_summary: Free plan at $0/month with 5k credits; paid plans are Starter $5/month (15k credits), Launch $12 for the first month and then $24/month (200k credits), and Core $99/month (1M credits). Business tiers are Scale at $330/month (4M credits) and Business at $880/month (22M credits).
features: Voice Universe library of user-generated voices
Voice Agent API, Text-to-Speech API, and Voice Changer API
use_cases: Building apps with AI voice agents
record.notes: The listed website, voice.ai, is live and is the product's official site. The current blurb, 'Change your voice in real time', is accurate but too narrow: the site now also offers text to speech, voice cloning, voice agents, audio tools, and APIs. Pricing comes from voice.ai/pricing. Launch is a first-month promotional price of $12, half the regular $24/month. The site also mentions an Enterprise option, but I did not confirm its terms on the pricing page, so it is not included. No legal company name beyond Voice.ai was confirmed because the search for the terms page did not finish. The site supports both PC and Mac.

record.short_description: Cloud-based AI transcription tool that converts voice, audio, and video recordings into text
record.description: Voicetapp is a cloud-based AI transcription service. It turns recorded voice, audio, and video into text using automatic speech recognition backed by AWS and Google Cloud Platform. Third-party sources say it handles more than 170 languages and dialects for recorded files, live transcription in 12 languages, speaker identification for up to five speakers, and automatic punctuation. It runs in a web browser, so nothing needs to be installed. One 2025 user review says it has grown into a wider AI platform that also has chat and image tools.
features: Speech to text in 170+ languages and dialects
Speaker identification for up to 5 speakers
Supports MP3, OGG, MP4 and WAV files
record.notes: Search results did not show the content of voicetapp.com itself. They listed only app.voicetapp.com, titled 'Voicetapp - AI Voice to Text Transcription', with a one-line description. All feature details come from third-party sources: Product Hunt, PCWorld, Entrepreneur, StackSocial and SourceForge. The company name could not be confirmed. Prices appear only on third-party sites, so pricing is left empty. Those prices vary and may be out of date: SourceForge lists $9 per 60 minutes, SaaSworthy lists Starter to Elite plans from $8.25/month, and StackSocial/DealFuel list lifetime deals at $39-$59.99. SaaSworthy's tiers and a 2025 Trustpilot review suggest the product may have grown into a wider AI platform (chat, image generation, voiceover), but this is not confirmed on the official site. Status is set to active because the app subdomain shows up in search results; I did not confirm that the site loads. The current blurb ('Transform your audio and video into text') matches the core transcription product.

record.short_description: AI research and document analysis platform for finance teams, investment banks, asset managers, and law firms
record.description: Hebbia is a New York-based company, founded in 2020 by George Sivulka, that builds AI software for finance and related professional work. Its flagship product, Matrix, lets users upload thousands of documents, models, transcripts, CRM exports, and memos into one workspace and pull from integrated sources such as S&P, CapIQ, PitchBook, and SEC filings. It returns structured, citation-linked outputs. The company markets the platform to asset managers, investment banks, law firms, and Fortune 500 companies, and offers an API and MCP server.
features: Upload thousands of documents, models, transcripts, CRM exports and memos
Deal team collaboration and firm-wide projects
Headless Hebbia API and MCP server
Mobile app for instant answers and deep research
ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications, SOC 2 Type 2 report
use_cases: Analysis of filings, earnings and investor decks
record.notes: The listed URL hebbia.ai is a Hebbia domain: it is on the X profile, trust.hebbia.ai, and security@hebbia.ai. But LinkedIn, Wikipedia, and the main marketing pages use hebbia.com, so that is used as official_url. I could not check whether hebbia.ai redirects. The search tool limit was reached, so pages were checked through search results and not opened directly. Hebbia publishes no prices on its own domain. Seat estimates (about $10K a year for Professional, $3K to $3.5K for Lite) come only from third-party sites like Sacra, Spellbook, and insearch.ai, so pricing is left empty. Third-party sources describe sales are handled only through its sales team. One third-party source mentions an acquisition of FlashDocs by Hebbia. Hebbia was not acquired, so status stays active. The current blurb 'Boost your decision-making with AI' is vague. The site describes itself as an AI platform for finance.

record.short_description: AI-powered design tool for making wireframes, mockups, and prototypes for apps and websites
record.description: Uizard is a browser-based UI design tool that uses AI to help people design user interfaces for web and mobile apps. It has a drag-and-drop editor, premade templates, and Autodesigner, which turns text prompts into multi-screen mockups you can edit. Other AI features turn screenshots and hand-drawn sketches into editable designs and create attention heatmaps. Teams can collaborate in real time. The Copenhagen-based company was acquired by Miro in 2024.
features: Screenshot Scanner to turn screenshots into editable designs
Wireframe Scanner to convert sketches into editable designs
use_cases: Designing app and website user interfaces
Visualizing product ideas without design experience
record.notes: Features come from Uizard's own pages (uizard.io/ui-design/ and uizard.io/design-assistant/). Those pages say 'Sign up for free', so the record shows a free tier. I couldn't open the official pricing page because I hit the search tool limit. Third-party sites (Tekpon, SaaSworthy, techpilot.ai, checkthat.ai) list a Free plan, Pro at $12 per creator/month billed yearly ($19 monthly), Business at $39 or $49, and custom Enterprise pricing. Those numbers aren't verified on uizard.io and don't agree with each other, so I left pricing_summary and pricing_source_url empty. Crunchbase, PitchBook, Tracxn, byFounders, and the founder's Indie Hackers post all say Miro bought Uizard in mid-2024 (dates given are May 24 or June 12, 2024). I didn't find this on Uizard's or Miro's own domain. The site is still up, and byFounders calls it 'Uizard by Miro Labs'. The current blurb is accurate but vague. A better one would mention AI-generated UI mockups, wireframes, and prototypes. I found no official integrations list. Some third-party sources mention React and CSS developer handoff, but I didn't verify this.

record.short_description: Cold email outreach platform with unlimited sending accounts, inbox warmup, B2B lead database, and CRM
record.description: Instantly is a sales engagement and cold email platform. Teams can send campaigns from unlimited email accounts, with inbox warmup and deliverability tools included. Its SuperSearch database holds over 450 million B2B leads drawn from several data providers and uses waterfall enrichment. AI can write personalized first lines for emails. Outreach, lead credits, and CRM are sold as separate subscriptions. Agencies, founders, and SDR teams use it to run high-volume outbound email.
record.pricing_summary: Outreach plans cost $47/mo for Growth (5,000 emails), $97/mo for Hypergrowth (125,000 emails), and $358/mo for Light Speed (500,000 emails), and Enterprise is custom. Lead credits are sold separately: a free trial with 100 credits, then Nano at $9/mo and Growth at $47–77/mo, up to Hyper Credits from $197/mo.
features: SISR private server and IP rotation (Light Speed)
use_cases: Outbound sales for founders and SDR teams
record.notes: Searched the web. The listed blurb ('Multiply your leads, meetings, and contracts by 10') is a slogan, and I could not confirm it on the current homepage, so it should be replaced. Pricing comes from instantly.ai/pricing.md, which is on Instantly's own domain. Third-party reviews also say annual billing costs about 20% less (for example, Growth at $37.60/mo). The free option is a trial with 100 lead credits, not a lasting free tier. Instantly also sells separate CRM plans; third-party sites put them at $47/mo and $97/mo, but I did not confirm those prices on Instantly's site. Features come from Instantly's own blog and its pricing page, plus third-party reviews (lemlist, ZoomInfo, Saleshandy). Unibox, A/Z testing, and email verification are supported only by those reviews. I verified no integrations. The search tool limit stopped me before I could open the homepage or integrations pages directly.

record.short_description: AI generators for advertising strategic briefs, creative campaign concepts, names and shot lists
record.description: Daydrm.ai is an AI tool for advertising creatives, strategists and agencies. It is built on language models trained on human-written creative advertising campaigns. It produces strategic briefs and on-demand creative concepts in formats such as YouTube viral films, experiential events, digital activations, Instagram campaigns and headlines. Users can save ideas to folders. Plans include a day pass, an unlimited-access subscription and an enterprise tier for agency and brand teams with a dedicated database and a custom domain.
record.pricing_summary: Day Rate is $5 per day for 24-hour unlimited access to all generators. Unlimited Access is $9/month or $86/year, and Enterprise is $39 per seat per month with a dedicated database, custom domain and encryption at rest.
features: Custom domain with dedicated server resources (Enterprise)
use_cases: Generating creative concepts for advertising campaigns
Headlines for social, ads and landing pages
Creating shot lists for video production

The pricing page lists no free plan. Some directories mention a free trial or try-for-free option, and older listings show a $19/month plan, but I could not confirm either on the official site. Generator names, PDF export, and folders come from third-party directories and a G2 review (futuretools, dang.ai, toolify, G2), not the official site. The current blurb is vague. The product is an AI tool for advertising ideas and strategic briefs, not general content creation. A related venture, Daydrm Studio (studio.daydrm.ai / daydrmstudio.com, run by Aaron Adler), offers AI-assisted video production and is separate from the SaaS tool. LinkedIn lists the company as founded in 2022 and based in New York, with 2-10 employees.

record.short_description: AI sidebar and apps that give access to multiple AI models in browsers and devices
record.description: Sider is an AI assistant from Vidline Inc. It works as a browser sidebar for Chrome and Edge and also has apps for Mac, Windows, iOS and Android. It gives users access to several AI models, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek, in one place. The company also lists Sider Omni, a sidebar that docks next to any app window, and Sider Desktop, a separate product for working with files, commands and web pages on a computer.
features: AI sidebar for Chrome and Edge
Access to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek in one app
Sider Omni sidebar that docks to any app window
Sider Desktop for working with files, commands and web pages
Apps for Mac, Windows, iOS and Android

AI help beside other apps on Mac
Working with files and web pages on desktop

Those sites disagree with each other: one lists Nano, Lite, Pro and Max plans at $100 to $1,000 per year, another lists older Basic, Pro and Unlimited plans, and others say there is a free plan with daily credits. Check the official pricing page before publishing. The current blurb ('fewer AI hallucinations') is not supported by any page I saw and reads like a slogan. Sider describes itself as an AI sidebar or assistant that gives access to many AI models. Reported user counts range from 6 million to 10 million or more depending on the source.

record.short_description: AI-assisted social media scheduling and automation platform for creators, brands, businesses, and agencies
record.description: FeedHive is a social media management platform for scheduling and publishing posts. It sells four plans: Creator, Brand, Business, and Agency. Each plan sets limits on social accounts, workspaces, AI credits, automation runs, and scheduled posts. The platform includes AI tools that help write posts, generate images and hashtags, and predict post performance. It also offers automation through post conditions, workflows, and webhooks, plus reusable post templates. Plans are aimed at individual creators, startups, growing businesses, and agencies with many clients.
record.pricing_summary: Prices billed annually: Creator $15/month ($180/yr, 4 social accounts), Brand $22/month ($264/yr, 10 accounts), Business $69/month ($828/yr, 100 accounts), and Agency $239/month ($2,868/yr, 500 accounts).
record.notes: The search tool hit its usage limit after two searches, so I couldn't open the homepage separately. This record is based only on the official pricing page at feedhive.com/pricing, which came up in search results. That page lists four paid plans and no free plan. It shows annual billing only; it may have a monthly-billing toggle with different prices. I couldn't confirm a free trial, monthly prices, or which social networks are supported (the page just says 'All supported platforms'), so integrations is left empty. A third-party review site mentions 'OpenClaw Skills' support, but I didn't include it because no FeedHive page I saw confirms it. The current blurb is accurate but generic and doesn't mention the AI and automation features.

record.short_description: AI keyword research tool that generates keywords, questions, topics, and blog outlines from seed keywords
record.description: Keywrds.ai is an AI-powered SEO keyword research tool. From a single seed keyword, it generates hundreds of related keywords and shows estimated search volume, keyword difficulty, and Google People Also Ask questions for them. Its GPT-4o-mini powered engine can also generate questions, topics, pain points, and blog post outlines, and it can write answers to People Also Ask questions automatically. The site pitches the tool as a way to build topic clusters and authority in a niche.
record.pricing_summary: The homepage lists one Beta Package at $19/month, billed monthly. It includes unlimited projects and 1,500 credits, and the page says the price will rise to $99/month after beta.
features: Seed keyword to hundreds of AI-generated keywords
Google People Also Ask question fetching
Automated answers to People Also Ask questions

Finding audience pain points and questions
Answering Google People Also Ask questions

record.short_description: AI photo and video editing platform for background removal, object removal, and image-to-video generation
record.description: Cutout.Pro is a browser-based AI visual design platform with photo and video editing tools. It automatically removes backgrounds from images and from videos without a green screen. It can also remove unwanted objects, people, scratches, and blemishes, and it includes AI video tools such as image-to-video. Developers can add its image and video processing to apps, websites, or company workflows through an HTTP API, including bulk background removal. The company says it was founded in 2018 and claims more than 25,000 business users.
record.pricing_summary: Uses credits: new accounts get 5 free HD credits, and one background removal costs 1 credit through either the web tool or the API. The official pages I opened did not show dollar prices for credit packs or subscriptions.
features: Video background removal without green screen
HTTP API for image and video AI processing
use_cases: Adding background removal to a design tool
record.notes: The product's name is Cutout.Pro (listed in the directory as 'CutOut'), so the directory name should probably be updated. I could not open the official pricing page because I ran out of searches. Third-party sites give dollar prices that disagree with each other (subscriptions said to start at $5/month for 40 or 80 credits, or $5.99/month; pay-as-you-go from $2.99 or $4.99), so I left those numbers out. A Shopify plugin and a 2024 data breach come only from third-party sources, so I did not confirm them. The 'freemium' label is based on the 5 free signup credits; third-party sites also mention free previews.

record.short_description: AI data analysis platform that generates spreadsheet formulas and analyzes spreadsheets, databases, and PDFs
record.description: Formula Bot, formerly Excel Formula Bot, is an AI data analytics platform for working with spreadsheets, databases, and documents in plain English, with no coding or SQL required. Users upload Excel files, CSVs, or PDFs, or connect a database. They can then ask questions and get insights, charts, and data exports. It also generates Excel formulas, converts PDFs to Excel, runs sentiment analysis, enriches data, and runs scheduled reports. Add-ons for Excel and Google Sheets are available.
record.pricing_summary: The Free plan costs $0/month and includes 10 messages and 25 AI Actions per month. Starter costs $18/month, or $12.58/month billed yearly, and includes 250 messages and 2,500 AI Actions per month. Max and Enterprise tiers are also listed.
use_cases: Generating Excel and Google Sheets formulas from plain English
Extracting data from PDFs into Excel
record.notes: The listed site, excelformulabot.com, is the product's old domain. CB Insights says the product was formerly called Excel Formulabot, and the current official site is formulabot.com. The blurb 'Work smarter and faster on Excel' is out of date: the product now presents itself as a general AI data analyst. Prices come from the official docs page, but the search snippet cut off before the Max and Enterprise prices. Third-party sites list other prices, such as $20 Starter, $40 Max and $80 Business; these were not verified on the official site. A single third-party review (itechguides) says Formula Bot was renamed 'Better Analyst' (betteranalyst.com). No official page confirmed this. A search limit stopped any further checking, so this should be checked by hand. The company name, Datasetmatch LLC, comes from the developer field on the Chrome Web Store, not from the official site. Excel add-in availability is based on the company's X post.

record.short_description: AI essay generator that turns a topic, word count, and essay type into a draft essay
record.description: EssayWriters.ai is a web-based AI essay writer for students. Users enter an essay topic, pick a word count, and choose an essay type. The tool then generates an essay draft. Its homepage lists essay types such as narrative, descriptive, analytical, reflective, expository, and cause-and-effect. It also offers AI autocomplete. A free plan allows essays of up to 150 words, and a paid Premium plan raises the limit to 1,500 words and adds unlimited essays and advanced options.
record.pricing_summary: Free plan at $0/month (up to 150 words, AI autocomplete); Premium plan at $5/month (up to 1,500 words, AI autocomplete, advanced essay options, unlimited essays), presented as a limited-time offer.
features: Generate essays from a topic, length, and essay type
Essay length up to 1,500 words on Premium
Multiple essay types (narrative, descriptive, analytical, reflective, expository, etc.)

The page did not show an operating company or legal entity, so company is left empty. The homepage claims 'zero plagiarism risk' and 'certified security,' but these are marketing statements and were not verified. Similar but separate products, such as MyEssayWriter.ai and PerfectEssayWriter.ai, should not be confused with this site. A third-party review site (nocramming.com) also lists EssayWriters.AI starting at $5.00/month with a free version.

record.short_description: No-code and code browser automation and web scraping tool delivered through a Chrome extension
record.description: Axiom.ai is a browser automation and web scraping tool from Axiom AI Limited, a Y Combinator company. Users can build bots without code in a Chrome extension, either by describing the task to an AI or by assembling prebuilt actions, scrapers and logic. Developers can write automations through a browser automation API, and a Claude skill can build bots from a plain-language description. Bots run on the user's own machine or on Axiom's cloud and can handle data entry, scraping and form filling.
features: No-code bot builder in a Chrome extension
Build by description (AI assembles the steps)
Prebuilt library of actions, scrapers and logic
Browser automation API for coded automations
Runs in the cloud or on your own machine
record.notes: The listed site, axiom.ai, is live and is the official site. It is a no-code browser automation and scraping tool. Don't confuse it with Axiom at axiom.co, a logging and observability product. The axiom.ai homepage mentions two free hours of runtime on desktop or cloud. I didn't open an official pricing page because I hit the search limit, so pricing_summary and pricing_type are blank or unknown. Third-party sites don't agree on price. Capterra and SaaSworthy list Starter at $15/mo up to $250/mo. SaaSPartout says plans start at $20/mo. Itechguides says there's no free plan. Zapier and webhooks are named only on third-party sites, so they're not in the integrations list. The company name comes from the Chrome Web Store publisher listing, and Y Combinator has a company page for it. The current blurb is accurate but vague. Something like 'No-code browser automation and web scraping via a Chrome extension' would describe it better.

record.short_description: Web tool that uses AI to generate photos of you with different hairstyles from your selfies
record.description: HairstyleAI is a web service for trying on haircuts virtually before getting a real cut. Users upload selfies, an AI photographer generates images of them with different hairstyles, and they download the ones they like. It works for both male and female haircuts. The site says it is powered by HeadshotPro.com and was founded in Holland. Each photoshoot is sold as a single one-time purchase and is delivered in about an hour.
record.pricing_summary: There is one one-time payment of $9 per photoshoot. It includes 30 unique hairstyles, 4 different poses/haircuts and 120 HD photos, delivered in about 1 hour.
use_cases: Try out new haircuts virtually before getting the real thing cut
See which hairstyles suit you without cutting your hair
Find the right hairstyle for an occasion or gathering
record.notes: The name and the URL in this row point to two different products. The listed website, hairbyai.com, is a separate product called 'Hair by AI', a hairstyle assistant for women. Third-party directories (aitoolhunt, aitoolguru, success.ai) list it from $29. Dang.ai says its review team has marked HairbyAI as 'closed, shutdown or acquired'. I could not open any page on hairbyai.com itself, so its status could not be confirmed from the official site. This record describes the product that matches the listed name, HairstyleAI at hairstyleai.com. Its homepage was the source for the features and the $9 one-time price, but the indexed copy of that page may be old (page age about 1274 days). Before publishing, the editor should choose between two fixes: change the URL to hairstyleai.com, or keep hairbyai.com and rename the row to 'Hair by AI' and mark its status as unknown or possibly shut down. Other similarly named products (hairstyleai.ai, hairstyleai.net, several App Store apps called 'Hairstyle AI') are unrelated and were not used here. The current blurb 'Find your ideal hairstyle' is vague but fits both products.

record.short_description: Discontinued AI chatbot that provided personalized health information and simulated physician conversations
record.description: Dr. Gupta was an AI physician chatbot at drgupta.ai. Martin Shkreli launched it in April 2023 as a virtual healthcare assistant. It answered health-related questions and gave personalized health information and suggestions, and its own branding said it was not an actual doctor. The drgupta.ai site now shows a notice saying the service has been discontinued so the team can focus on other projects. The notice says the service handled more than a million messages and lists a support email for questions.

record.company: Beijing PAI Technology Ltd. (PAI Tech / Paodingai)
record.short_description: AI assistant for chatting with PDFs and other documents, with answers linked to cited sources

record.short_description: AI writing platform with thousands of task-specific templates for content, copy, and everyday writing
record.description: LogicBalls is a web-based AI writing platform. Instead of relying on one general chatbot, it offers thousands of task-specific tools, such as a content and copy generator, a UX writing generator, and a synopsis generator. It describes its method as clarification-first: it asks two or three questions about context, audience, and goals before it writes, to cut down on made-up content. It also has a chat assistant and access to multiple AI models. Many tools can be used free without signing up, within daily limits.
record.pricing_summary: Free plan at $0 with 2,000+ tools and 10,000 AI words per month. Paid annual plans are Pro at $59.99/yr (shown as $5/mo, 150K words), Premium at $99/yr ($8.25/mo, 500K words), and Elite at $139.99/yr ($11.67/mo, unlimited words), plus an Enterprise option.
features: Support for multiple AI models (3 free, up to 31 on Elite)

record.notes: Official site and pricing page found. The current blurb is a vague slogan; LogicBalls is an AI writing tool platform. record.short_description: AI copywriting app for writing sales pages, email campaigns, headlines, ads and social media content

record.short_description: Crypto trading and portfolio management platform that connects multiple exchanges and runs automated trading bots
record.description: Quadency is a cryptocurrency trading, automation, and portfolio management platform launched in 2018 and based in New York. It links accounts from many centralized exchanges through API keys, so users can track assets, place trades, and run strategies from one dashboard. The platform offers pre-built and custom trading bots, an AI strategy assistant called Cody, backtesting, advanced charting, and market analytics.
